Commentary.Commentary: Now this is not going to be an easy task but not an impossible one too. The wicket is a good one to bat on but you need to apply yourself. Can Lanka do so? South Africa on the other hand, would hope to make use of the new ball. Join us for the reply in a bit.

When the day began, it seemed Lanka would be chasing over 400 as Stubbs and Bavuma were batting brilliantly but one wicket got about a procession. At one time it seemed, The lead would not cross 300 but credit to the lower order who have managed to add handy runs and taken the lead close to 350.

South Africa did well after the break! They came out, batted with intent, scored some quick runs and have taken their lead very close to 350. Overall though, it is Lanka who have dominated the day so far and it is that man, Prabath Jayasuriya who is leading them off the field, the star for them.
